text:
Ava Thompson: Hi team  Im Ava, joining as Backend Engineer remote from London (GMT). Day 1 questions: who should I ping for VPN/repo access that respects EU data routing? Also my laptop was shipped to the EU hub but tracking shows clearance delay  anyone to nudge? :uk:
Ravi Menon: welcome Ava! Ping #eng-infra for VPN and repo. For EU routing, mention "eu-region" in your request and infra will ensure traffic stays in eu-west. Ill also poke the courier if you paste the tracking here.
Ava Thompson: thanks Ravi  tracking: DHL EU 7ZHK1234567890  says "customs review". Also is there a corporate SIM program or stipend for UK hires? Might need a local number for OTPs.
PeopleOpsBot: Hi Ava  People Ops sees the customs delay and will open an expedited request. Corporate SIM: available via expense code "MOBILITY-UK"  file a ticket and Finance will approve.
Sofie Larsson: hi Ava  Sofie from Eng on-call. Welcome! For timezone-friendly standups we have a rotating hat so you won't be on the 09:30 PST rota. If youre on-call routing questions ping me and Ill show you the timezone-aware rota policy.
Ava Thompson: excellent, thx. dropping my public key to pre-authorize repos (happy to DM if preferred):
```
ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIFakeKeyAva ava@laptop
```
eng-infra-bot: SSH key attached to Ava Thompson. Repository access scheduled. If provisioning fails, a ticket will be opened as IT-5409. For EU routing include tag: eu-region.
Mateo Ruiz: hey Ava  Mateo from People Ops. Badge pickup isn't needed for remote hires but we can ship a welcome box (stickers, mug, plant cuttings). Reply "box: yes" and confirm mailing address in DM. Also we can include a noise-cancelling headset if needed.
Ava Thompson: box: yes  will DM address. Would love a headset  noise is rough in my flat. Also quick intro fun fact: two truths & a lie: I used to run a pop-up restaurant, I speak 4 languages, I hate elevators.
Sofie Larsson: good one! Ill guess languages = true, pop-up restaurant = true, hate elevators = lie?
Ravi Menon: my money on the elevator thing being a lie  people usually say they hate them but secretly use them.
Ava Thompson: reveal: pop-up restaurant = true, speak 4 languages = true (english, spanish, swedish, french), lie = hate elevators (I actually ride elevators all the time lol). Thanks everyone for the warm welcome  Ill follow up with Ravi and DM Mateo about the box.
PeopleOpsBot: Welcome Ava Thompson! New-hire checklist: payroll/bank invite sent, benefits packet scheduled, IT ticket IT-5409 opened for asset tracking. Reminder: complete security training by day 5.
